text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide loses at the Kikuka<n>Sho, but she
looks proud and<n>satisfied to have put everything on
the line to win.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Narita Taishin and<n>Winning Ticket
stop by to exchange<n>compliments and
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The next race is the spring Tenno<n>Sho. There, we'll
have our rematch<n>with Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide vows to win it with a<n>smile that is
much, much brighter than<n>it has been recently.
